stats.done_summary: Completed the research task. Preprocessed the data, computed quantitative summaries, and generated visualizations. Used the Gemini 2.5 Pro model via OpenRouter to perform structured triage, propose a label set, summarize patterns, and contrast EDR vs Network IDS alerts. Saved the raw JSON response and wrote a comprehensive report detailing the methodology, results, discussion, and limitations.
